name: TIC 141544753

text.card: A red giant 1,217 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.06 solar masses and 11.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,826 K at its surface.
